title: Finally released my game on playgama! Casual roller coaster where you hold on and try not to crash!
author: MapApprehensive1867
selftext:
# 🛠️ How it was built



**- Code**: created by 5.6 Sol. The game is written in TypeScript, and the physics engine is compiled to WebAssembly with AssemblyScript so every platform plays exactly the same.

**- Rendering**: HTML5 Canvas, with a custom candy-style interface.

**- Art**: carts, riders, power-ups, effects, worlds, trophies and badges were generated with Imagen, then cleaned up and layered for the game.

**- Music**: "Level Up" and "Dreamy Lo-Fi Chillhop Beat" by MusicbyEll (Pixabay).

**- Font**: M PLUS Rounded 1c (Google Fonts).

**- Build tools**: esbuild, sharp (WebP image compression), FFmpeg for the trailer.

**- Published on**: [Playgama](https://playgama.com/game/rollercoaster-craze)
